description: The flaky-test quarantine (plan v3 M7, D-065 V7, D-069 item 5): test.flaked, test.quarantined, test.unquarantined.

quarantine.max_age_s.description: Age of an open quarantine after which `scripts/quarantine list` marks it overdue: the owner's stabilizing PR is late and the maestro escalates.

quarantine.step_prefix.description: Prefix of the engine.step.measured step names the quarantine emits (quarantine:flaked, quarantine:release).

quarantine.test_roots.description: Prefixes tried, in order, to turn a test id (a test file as the runner prints it, relative to its package) into a repository path for the unit manifests' globs. The defect register derives a test's owner with the same prefixes.

quarantine.unknown_owner.description: Owner of a quarantined test that no unit manifest (units/<id>/unit.json) covers: today every test, until U0's manifests exist. This owner may also release such a test with any merged stabilizing PR.
